trust_decision.summary: Which network endpoint (host, delivery host, proxy, extra headers, config file) receives the server's CMA PAT must be decided by server config, not by LLM-controlled tool args; at the pinned commit export_space/import_space spread all args into the contentful-export/contentful-import options next to managementToken.

landing_point.why: Summary names export_space/import_space and host/proxy; the `...args` spread beside managementToken is the obvious spot, with the host/proxy schema fields at exportSpace.ts:99-105.

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool export_space (input schema: drops deliveryToken, host, hostDelivery, proxy, rawProxy, headers, config)
MCP tool export_space (options build: host/deliveryToken/hostDelivery forced from config)
MCP tool import_space (input schema: drops host, proxy, rawProxy, headers, config)
MCP tool import_space (options build: host forced from config)
public library API ContentfulMcpTools constructor config (adds deliveryToken, hostDelivery)
server startup registerAllTools passes new delivery config into ContentfulMcpTools

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/mcp-tools/src/tools/jobs/space-to-space-migration/exportSpace.ts:115-118 and packages/mcp-tools/src/tools/jobs/space-to-space-migration/importSpace.ts:92-95 (`config` arg: path to a JSON options file that contentful-export/import merge into their options inside the dependency)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: `config` looks like a local file-path option (a file-handling concern, not a network one), and the host/proxy values it can carry are merged inside the third-party contentful-export/import packages, out of view of the MCP code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: export with a CDA deliveryToken (and custom delivery host) to export only published content must keep working; the fix moves it to server config instead of deleting it. A custom CONTENTFUL_HOST (e.g. EU api.eu.contentful.com) must still be honoured, so hard-coding api.contentful.com is over-broad.

O6_input_shapes: proxy (string, host:port or user:pass@host:port) on export and import
rawProxy (boolean, raw proxy object handed to Axios) on export and import
headers (record<string> on export, record<any> on import)
config (string path to JSON options file merged by the dependency) on export and import
deliveryToken (string) on export, moved to server config

O7_producer.where: contentful-export/contentful-import option parsing of the `config` file (dependency code, not in the repo tree; reached via packages/mcp-tools/src/tools/jobs/space-to-space-migration/exportSpace.ts:148 and packages/mcp-tools/src/tools/jobs/space-to-space-migration/importSpace.ts:119)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Direct library use of @contentful/mcp-tools (ContentfulMcpTools.getJobTools().exportSpace/importSpace.tool) bypasses MCP SDK Zod stripping, so `...args` still forwards proxy/rawProxy/headers/config after the fix (only host/deliveryToken/hostDelivery are forced).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The fix comment says Zod strips unknown fields before the handler, and the README shows the tools registered with inputParams as the schema, so direct callers can be called trusted.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, same package (mcp-tools root vs jobs/space-to-space-migration)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Param-collection tool still advertises host/hostDelivery/proxy/rawProxy/headers/config and returns them as workflowParams; a sibling that forwards confirmed workflowParams straight into export/import would be a realistic second route.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tool already collects these params for the export/import step (paramCollection.ts:300-308), and a maintainer automating the workflow would pass them on unchanged.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: createToolClient taking an optional per-call host/environment override from tool params (e.g. for EU-region spaces) into createClient.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: BaseToolSchema params are already merged here (spaceId); adding a region/host param is a plausible feature request.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: updateConfig reachable from a tool (e.g. a context/set-region tool) letting the LLM set config.host, which the fixed code then trusts.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: updateConfig already exists as a public runtime mutator; the fix moves trust onto config.host, so the producer of config.host becomes the protected item.

O9_family: SSRF / credential forwarding to an attacker-chosen endpoint (CWE-918)

O10_build.project_tests: packages/mcp-tools/src/tools/jobs/space-to-space-migration/{exportSpace,importSpace,paramCollection,migrationHandler}.test.ts mock contentful-export/contentful-import and assert the options passed
